title: Normalization profile
limitations: An omitted optional TOML key has no value unless a default is shown. TOML has no null literal.
A required rule mapping can be supplied by the common normalization table or by a rule item. An item cannot override a common key.
The catalogue validates namespace, target, field references and cross-field semantics. Runtime readers enforce data-dependent constraints.
The authoring reference does not guarantee compilation or input compatibility. Use Rust profile validation and a representative sample.

sections.title: Identity
sections.description: Schema discriminator, installed identity and inventory-only marker. Match the venue, instrument and market to the catalogue.

sections.title: Source
sections.description: Archive wrapper, record representation and source layout.

sections.title: Fields
sections.description: Replace <name> with a real source column or JSON path. Use [fields."data.ts"] for a dotted raw key. Omit optional TOML keys to leave them unset unless a default is documented.

sections.title: Normalization
sections.description: Map raw fields to canonical operations. Use [[normalization.rules]] for multiple targets. Each item inherits common mappings and cannot override a common key.

sections.title: Feeds
sections.description: Gate.io depth can declare snapshot and incremental feed variants. Replace <feed> with one of those keys. Each feed supplies its own source, fields and normalization.
